title: DIY Macrame Bag, Shoulder Macramé Bag, Macrame Purse Tutorial
description:
DIY macramé bag In floral design.

Thank you for watching and supporting me!

00:19 Please pause the video for the measurements. For this project I used soft 3mm braided cord. 00:25 all lengths are in centimeters. The type of cord and how tight you knot affects the overall cord consumption.
04:20 Pattern on the bag front
34:33 Bag strap. For the bag strap use 4 cords of 800cm long. I took short cords for an example.

Size of the finished handbag - 18х25cm (Macrame part);
fringed front length - 25cm;
bag strap length - 115cm.
